mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, reducing the present value of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 5.0% signals labor market tightness, reducing recession risk and increasing corporate profit expectations, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate robust consumer demand, elevating corporate revenue expectations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and GDPC1 both increase from prior period
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and GDPC1 fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized) triggers Federal Reserve rate hikes (FEDFUNDS rise), increasing equity discount rates and reducing valuations, which causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, strengthening corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of periods over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth exceeding 0.5% monthly signals robust job creation, increasing consumer spending power and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above 12-month moving averages indicate sustained consumer spending strength, elevating corporate revenue forecasts and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both exceed 12-month moving averages
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST above 12-month averages fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (GDP growth > 2.5% and housing starts rising) indicates market overvaluation, triggering profit-taking and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and HOUST growth > 0.0% (from prior period)
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDP growth exceeds 2.5% and housing starts are rising.
